request: Record power-law fit quality and correlate it with training, validation, and test accuracy; measure test accuracy if not already measured.
test_policy: Evaluate the complete official IMDb test partition at initialization and every completed epoch, alongside frozen-model training and validation metrics.
test_role: Monitoring and descriptive correlations only. Validation remains the selection source. Test measurements do not control optimization, early stopping, schedules, or sweep generation.
data: The original training/validation split and prepared.json remain unchanged. Separate test_tokens.npz and test_prepared.json freeze test inputs and record exposure.
fit_quality: Default WeightWatcher 0.7.7 analyze(); raw unnormalized matrices. Retain D, alpha, sigma, xmin, xmax, num_pl_spikes, num_evals, status and warnings.
D_definition: Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance for the fitted power-law tail; lower D means a closer empirical-tail fit. D is not a p-value.
correlations: Per-layer and model-average metrics versus all three accuracies. Separate single-run trajectories from between-configuration comparisons; use complete three-seed configuration means for the latter, stratified by optimizer and fixed protocol.
interpretation: Record repeated test exposure in reports. No unobserved test results or fit-quality correlations are inferred from the pilot.
